title: Design System: CSHighlighter Beatgrid Control Room

display.purpose: Large task headings and the home promise; weight and scale carry the hierarchy.

label.purpose: Workflow lanes, state labels, counts, and measurements only.

shadows.name: surface-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separate major work surfaces from the page.

shadows.name: action-lift
shadows.purpose: Give the primary action a small, deliberate lift.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Buttons, borders, surfaces, and selection states.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove movement while preserving state and feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action for upload, submit, and current work.

components.name: Input Field
components.description: A quiet field that belongs to the control room instead of a marketing card.

components.name: Control Surface
components.description: A major work surface for capture, editing, profile, and delivery states.

components.name: Workflow Strip
components.description: The signature bridge from raw demo to finished movie.
components.css: .ds-workflow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:0;border-block:1px solid #2a353d;padding:15px 0;list-style:none}.ds-workflow li{display:grid;gap:5px;border-left:1px solid #2a353d;padding-left:12px}.ds-workflow li.is-active{border-left-color:#ff623d}.ds-workflow span,.ds-workflow small{color:#71d8d4;font:700 10px monospace;letter-spacing:.08em}.ds-workflow strong{color:#f2efe8;font:800 12px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}

narrative.overview: A measured production console for CS2 editors. Graphite surfaces, warm text, signal-orange action, and data-cyan state keep the work legible while the workflow strip makes the path from demo to movie memorable.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Orange is reserved for actions and current work; cyan is reserved for data.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a second display family; hierarchy comes from scale, weight, and the signal vocabulary.

rules.name: The Layer Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use a tonal surface or structural line first; use a shadow only when a surface truly needs to lift.

dos: Do make the next operational action visible within the first viewport.
Do keep controls keyboard reachable with a visible focus treatment.
Do let responsive layouts collapse structurally.
donts: Don't reintroduce gradient text, glass cards, or decorative grid texture.
Don't use a second display font for a technical mood.
Don't let workflow lanes create horizontal page overflow on narrow screens.
